newsitem.title: LATVIA: FINNISH DETROIT GROUP SIGNS DEAL WITH RAF - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH DETROIT GROUP SIGNS DEAL WITH RAF - REPORT.

text.p: Finnish Detroit Group has signed an agreement with bankrupt minibus maker RAF under which it will lease the premises of the vehicle firm for six months and may begin production again next week, newspapers said on Monday.
Newspapers Dienas Bizness and Bizness I Baltiya said an agreement between the Finnish group and the administrator appointed by the privatisation agency was signed on July 8.
Detroit Group emerged around 18 months ago as a possible privatiser of the company. The lease agreement was signed to December 31 but can be extended.
Detroit also agreed to buy 196 microbuses to complete and sell. It also plans to introduce new technology.
